# envelope: `Envelope`

The wrapper around every command with `--json`. The command's payload is `data` (on success) or `error` (on failure).

Success or failure wrapper.

JSON Schema: [`docs/schema/envelope.schema.json`](https://github.com/openreadout/openreadout/blob/main/docs/schema/envelope.schema.json) · also printed by `openreadout self schema envelope`.

## Fields

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ok` | `boolean` | yes | True on success (`data` present), false on failure (`error` present). |
| `schema_version` | `string` | yes | [`SCHEMA_VERSION`] at the time of writing. |
| `tool` | [`ToolId`](#toolid) | yes | The producing tool. |
| `path` | `string` or `null` |  | The input this envelope answers for, in batch mode (`--jsonl`, JSON arrays, MCP `openreadout_batch`); absent for single-file commands. |
| `data` | any JSON |  | The command's output, on success. |
| `error` | [`ErrorBody`](#errorbody) or `null` |  | What went wrong, on failure. |

## Types

### ToolId

Identifies the producing tool so consumers can reason about compatibility.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | yes | Always `openreadout`. |
| `version` | `string` | yes | The tool's version (`CARGO_PKG_VERSION`). |

### ErrorBody

Structured error body. `hint` is meant to be actionable by an agent.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | `string` | yes | Stable code: `unknown_format`, `unsupported_feature`, `corrupt_file`, `usage`, `io`, `error`, `internal_panic` (a bug: the tool panicked; please report it). |
| `message` | `string` | yes | Human-readable description of the failure. |
| `hint` | `string` or `null` |  | What to try next, when the tool knows. |
| `exit_code` | `integer` (int32) | yes | The process exit code for this error (see the crate docs). |
